SFCC-123 "Spike: Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model" — Jira **Spike**, project SFCC (zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net), label Squad-A, High, **In Progress**. Parent epic **SFCC-1** (Platform Setup & Environments). **Assignee: Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz**; reporter Jasmijn Tsang. Created 2026-07-08. Sibling spikes: SFCC-121/122 (see [[sfcc-122]]). Board house style Objective/Background/Tasks/DoD (see [[f2r-spike]]).

Objective: document the Contentful→MRT→SFCC integration + data flow, define Sprint 1/2 content types, define what SFCC consumes (APIs, fields, rendering), locale config across the storefronts, and the Accenture-vs-incoming-Contentful-squad handoff boundary. DoD: a TSD briefing artefact for the incoming Contentful squad.

Ticket timeline: 2026-07-21 Jhoan posted first draft `Contentful Integration TSD_SFCC123.docx`; 2026-07-21 Marcel attached `tsd-integration-template.md`; 2026-07-22 Marcel handed Jhoan a spike-specific TSD skeleton (Jira attachment).

**Deliverable created 2026-07-22:** `zimmermann-pwa/.docs/spikes/SFCC-123-contentful-integration-tsd.md` (176 lines, fact-checked against code/Confluence/Jira, dash-convention clean), filled from Marcel's template at `~/Downloads/Zimmermann-PWA/TSD-Templates/specific-tsds/sfcc-123-contentful-integration-tsd.md`. Section tags map to DoD pillars/ticket tasks. Iterated via a create/check/improve loop to DoD (~190 lines): added an At-a-glance summary, explicit Sprint 1 vs Sprint 2 content-type requirements, and code-verified shoppable-image detail (`useProduct` SCAPI hook, product image from SFCC DIS `disBaseLink`). An independent reviewer subagent confirmed all DoD criteria pass and spot-checked every code claim true. NOT yet published to Confluence and NOT yet linked on the ticket (same publish-approval pattern as [[sfcc-122]]). Sibling deliverable SFCC-122 lives at `zimmermann-pwa/.docs/spikes/SFCC-122-mrt-api-capabilities.md`.

**Crux/reframe (same shape as [[sfcc-122]]):** the SFCC-side Contentful integration is already substantially BUILT & documented, not greenfield discovery. Codebase `zimmermann-pwa`: `scripts/contentful/` (sync.js, migrations/, setup/ bootstrapSpace+getConfig+runMigrations+promoteAlias+detectDrift, generateDefinitions.mjs), `overrides/app/components/contentful/` (heroBanner, duplexSection, productHero, videoEmbed) + `experiences/` (collectionHero, imageText, shoppableImage, hotspotPopup/Marker), `hooks/useContentful.ts`, config/contentful.ts + contentfulMapping(.generated).ts, types/contentful.ts, `.claude/skills/contentful-register-component`, CI contentful-drift-audit + Husky pre-commit drift check. Deps: contentful, contentful-management, contentful-cli, @contentful/experiences-sdk-react, @contentful/live-preview. Integration doc: `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` (CDA/CPA/CMA split, publish webhook→MRT cache purge, SSR-first+GraphQL, Images API, failure modes). Architecture: single Contentful Space, one env per delivery tier.

Key findings (verified 2026-07-22): (a) **Locale RESOLVED** — not a data conflict, a category error: 8 SFCC sites/storefront catalogues (EU carries 5 locales), 10 PWA sites (EU domestic split into en/fr/it/es single-locale PWA sites), 9 distinct Contentful locales (`en` default, en-US, en-GB, fr, it, es, en-CH, en-HK, en-AE) per `config/sites.overlay.js` + `contentfulMapping.ts`. `02-contentful.md §7`'s "Eleven" is WRONG (wrongly includes `en-AU` = BM site default the AU PWA overrides to `en`, plus a separate `en (EU)`); fix §7 to 9 — pending. (b) Content model immature: only `shoppableImage` CDA content type codified + 3 Studio Experiences (collection-hero/image-text/shoppable-image); editorial components heroBanner/duplexSection/videoEmbed/productHero exist without a confirmed content type. (c) **Current code vs documented target diverges:** live data layer `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` is a BROWSER-SIDE REST fetch (CDA/CPA, include=2); the SSR-first fetch, GraphQL Content API, and publish-webhook receiver described in `02-contentful.md §3`/PWA TSD §7 are NOT yet built. (d) **NEW discrepancy:** product image ownership contradicts across Confluence — PWA TSD (256835585) §11 says ALL imagery incl. product served from Contentful (images.ctfassets.net; DMU-010/CRM-075/HPC-003), but Product TSD (292061208) §4.3/§9 say product images load directly into SFCC, no external DAM. (e) Ownership (`02-contentful.md §1`) marks PLP/PDP editorial split, mega-menu promo tiles, category-landing routing *pending*. (f) Human setup checklist incomplete: MRT env vars per tier, Contentful→MRT cache-purge webhook, Contentful roles, CI CMA GitHub secret. (g) **Hard blocker** (Confluence 268337165): Contentful must provide per-env credentials (Space ID, CDA/CPA tokens, webhook secret). Contentful integration is NOT a separate sprint — it rides each functional story (`.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`). Mapped Contentful stories: SFCC-51 (promo banner, Blocked), 55 (footer), 82/203 (PLP bottom zone), 90 (homepage modules), 102 (PDP size-guide fallback, non-Measmerize), 151 (locale/URL config, 8 storefronts), 173 (SEO FAQ/Article JSON-LD), 190/204 (PLP inline grid insert).

Key Confluence (space SFCC): 318472193 "Contentful CMS — Setup & Operations" (v7, ops runbook: 6-tier env topology, alias/release workflow, token matrix, locales, content types, drift, scripts, checklist), 292061208 (TSD Product), 303890433 (Third Party Integrations — App Exchange connector + Delivery API), 257327107 (PDP editorial blocks), 303104002 (Regional Storefronts/locales), 268337165 (Third Party Credentials — blocker), 258408463 (Decision Log — images Contentful vs SFCC), 303071234 (Homepage & Content model/authoring), 257163278 (Product — content-type open questions).

I re-read the on-disk artifact and validated its external claims directly against the live sources (the code-focused verifier had left Confluence/Jira out of scope). Outcome:

**Fixed (2):**
- **Citation error** — the "all imagery served from Contentful" contradiction was attributed to PWA TSD §11; it's actually **§9 Performance Strategy**. Corrected.
- **Credentials blocker refined** — added the missing **environment ID** to the required-credentials list, corrected the owner to **Zimmermann IT / Contentful** (per the page's "Who Provides"), and noted status "not yet requested" + the six environments. The "storefront cannot connect without these" wording was confirmed verbatim.

**Passed (confirmed accurate, no change):**
- All **11 Jira statuses** re-fetched live and unchanged (123 In Progress; 51 Blocked; 90/82/102/151 In Refinement; 55 Tech design; 203/190/204/173 To Do).
- Product-TSD Open Item #3 = this spike; Product TSD §5 = 8 sites; EU = 5 BM locales; Transperfect/REG-047; §7.3 schema-as-code; ops-checklist gaps 4/5/8/9 — all verified.
- Final state clean: no em/en dashes, all 15 links resolve, all PWA-TSD section refs now correct (§9, §7, §7.3).

The TSD ([`zimmermann-pwa/.docs/spikes/SFCC-123-contentful-integration-tsd.md`](../../zimmermann-pwa/.docs/spikes/SFCC-123-contentful-integration-tsd.md)) is now validated against codebase, Confluence, and Jira, and holds up. Memory updated.

Still awaiting your go-ahead on the outward-facing steps (none done without approval): **commit** to `feature/your-ticket-onboarding-setup`, **draft-publish** to Confluence, **link/comment on SFCC-123**, and the small **`02-contentful.md §7` locale fix** (Eleven → 9). Want me to proceed with any?

content.content:
1	# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)
2	
3	> **Status:** 🟡 In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
4	> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
5	> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## At a glance
10	
11	- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
12	- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
13	- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
14	- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
15	- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
16	- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]
21	
22	**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.
23	
24	- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
25	- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.
26	
27	Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).
28	
29	## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]
30	
31	**Target pattern** (per [`.docs/integration/02-contentful.md`](../integration/02-contentful.md) §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.
32	
33	```
34	PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
35	   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
36	   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
37	   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
38	   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
39	   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
40	```
41	
42	| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
43	|---|---|---|---|
44	| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
45	| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
46	| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
47	| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |
48	
49	CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).
50	
51	> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is [`overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`](../../overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts): two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from [`overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`](../../overrides/app/config/contentful.ts) via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.
52	
53	## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]
54	
55	**What exists in code today (verified):**
56	
57	- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in [`experiences/definitions.ts`](../../overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/definitions.ts), autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
58	- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** ([`scripts/contentful/content-types/`](../../scripts/contentful/content-types/)): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in [`contentfulMapping.ts`](../../overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts).
59	- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` ([`components/contentful/index.ts`](../../overrides/app/components/contentful/index.ts)).
60	
61	Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per [`.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`](../memory/sprintScope.md), "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).
62	
63	**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert) and the PDP size-guide fallback; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.
64	
65	| Content type | Purpose | Sprint | Exists in code? | Backing story (status) | SFCC component |
66	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
67	| Collection hero | Homepage / campaign hero | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp `collection-hero` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `experiences/collectionHero.tsx` |
68	| Image + text block | Editorial image + text | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp `image-text` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) | `experiences/imageText.tsx` |
69	| Shoppable image | Shop-the-look, product hotspots | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp + CDA type `shoppableImage` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) | `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` |
70	| Homepage modules | Hero banner, featured tiles, campaign links, top categories, editorial/boutique duo | 1 | Partial: `heroBanner.tsx`, `duplexSection.tsx` (no confirmed content type) | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `components/contentful/{heroBanner,duplexSection}.tsx` |

# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** 🟡 In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per [`.docs/integration/02-contentful.md`](../integration/02-contentful.md) §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is [`overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`](../../overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts): two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from [`overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`](../../overrides/app/config/contentful.ts) via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

**What exists in code today (verified):**

- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in [`experiences/definitions.ts`](../../overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/definitions.ts), autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** ([`scripts/contentful/content-types/`](../../scripts/contentful/content-types/)): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in [`contentfulMapping.ts`](../../overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts).
- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` ([`components/contentful/index.ts`](../../overrides/app/components/contentful/index.ts)).

Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per [`.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`](../memory/sprintScope.md), "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).

**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert) and the PDP size-guide fallback; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.

| Collection hero | Homepage / campaign hero | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp `collection-hero` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `experiences/collectionHero.tsx` |

| Homepage modules | Hero banner, featured tiles, campaign links, top categories, editorial/boutique duo | 1 | Partial: `heroBanner.tsx`, `duplexSection.tsx` (no confirmed content type) | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `components/contentful/{heroBanner,duplexSection}.tsx` |
| Promotional announcement banner | Site-wide rotating promo bar | 1 | ❌ | [SFCC-51](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-51) (**Blocked**) | to build |

| PLP inline grid insert | Campaign image / image+text / featured tile insert | 2 | ❌ | UI [SFCC-190](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-190) (To Do) · content [SFCC-204](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-204) (To Do) | to build |

| SEO FAQ / Article schema | JSON-LD structured data authored in Contentful | Backlog (Enhancements) | ❌ | [SFCC-173](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-173) (To Do) | to build |
| (existing, unmapped) | `productHero`, `videoEmbed` components exist without a confirmed content type | - | ✅ component only | - | `components/contentful/{productHero,videoEmbed}.tsx` |

**Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

1	> ⚠️ **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.

3	# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)
4	
5	> **Status:** 🟡 In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22

8	
9	---
10	
11	## At a glance
12	
13	- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
14	- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
15	- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
16	- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
17	- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
18	- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

20	---
21	
22	## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]
23	
24	**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.
25	
26	- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
27	- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.
28	
29	Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).
30	
31	## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]
32	
33	**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.
34	
35	```
36	PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
37	   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
38	   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
39	   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
40	   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
41	   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
42	```
43	
44	| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
45	|---|---|---|---|
46	| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
47	| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
48	| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
49	| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |
50	
51	CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).
52	
53	> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.
54	
55	## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

60	- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
61	- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).
62	
63	Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).
64	
65	**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert) and the PDP size-guide fallback; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. # TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** 🟡 In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

**What exists in code today (verified):**

- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in `experiences/definitions.ts`, autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).

Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).

**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert) and the PDP size-guide fallback; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. **Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

## 3. SFCC-side consumption & build scope [DoD-4 · Task-3]

**Already built (verified against the tree):**

- **Config / types:** `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`, `config/contentfulMapping.ts` + `contentfulMapping.generated.ts` (`SUPPORTED_LOCALES`, `SITE_LOCALES`, `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENTS`, `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS`, `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD`), `types/contentful.ts`.

- **Editorial components:** `components/contentful/{heroBanner, duplexSection, videoEmbed, productHero}.tsx`.

> ⚠️ **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.

# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** 🟡 In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

**What exists in code today (verified):**

- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in `experiences/definitions.ts`, autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).

Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).

**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert) and the PDP size-guide fallback; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.

| Content type | Purpose | Sprint | Exists in code? | Backing story (status) | SFCC component |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Collection hero | Homepage / campaign hero | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp `collection-hero` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `experiences/collectionHero.tsx` |
| Image + text block | Editorial image + text | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp `image-text` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) | `experiences/imageText.tsx` |
| Shoppable image | Shop-the-look, product hotspots | 1 | ✅ Studio Exp + CDA type `shoppableImage` | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) | `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` |
| Homepage modules | Hero banner, featured tiles, campaign links, top categories, editorial/boutique duo | 1 | Partial: `heroBanner.tsx`, `duplexSection.tsx` (no confirmed content type) | [SFCC-90](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-90) (In Refinement) | `components/contentful/{heroBanner,duplexSection}.tsx` |
| Promotional announcement banner | Site-wide rotating promo bar | 1 | ❌ | [SFCC-51](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-51) (**Blocked**) | to build |
| Global footer | CMS-managed footer, per-storefront | 1 | ❌ | [SFCC-55](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-55) (Tech design) | to build |
| PLP bottom-zone editorial | Full-width image / editorial feature / two-column block | 2 | ❌ (UI shells in SFCC-82) | UI [SFCC-82](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-82) (In Refinement) · content [SFCC-203](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-203) (To Do) | to build |
| PLP inline grid insert | Campaign image / image+text / featured tile insert | 2 | ❌ | UI [SFCC-190](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-190) (To Do) · content [SFCC-204](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-204) (To Do) | to build |
| PDP size-guide fallback | Per-product-type size guide slide-out (non-Measmerize) | 2 | ❌ | [SFCC-102](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-102) (In Refinement) | to build (SFCC-owned overlay) |
| SEO FAQ / Article schema | JSON-LD structured data authored in Contentful | Backlog (Enhancements) | ❌ | [SFCC-173](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-173) (To Do) | to build |
| (existing, unmapped) | `productHero`, `videoEmbed` components exist without a confirmed content type | - | ✅ component only | - | `components/contentful/{productHero,videoEmbed}.tsx` |

**Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

**Already built (verified against the tree):**

- **Config / types:** `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`, `config/contentfulMapping.ts` + `contentfulMapping.generated.ts` (`SUPPORTED_LOCALES`, `SITE_LOCALES`, `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENTS`, `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS`, `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD`), `types/contentful.ts`.

That is wrong on two counts: the canonical set is **9**, and `en-AU` is Business Manager's site-level default for the AU realm, which the AU PWA site narrows to `en` in the overlay. ## 5. Handoff boundary, Accenture vs Contentful squad [Task-5]

| Concern | Accenture (SFCC-side) builds | Incoming Contentful squad owns |
|---|---|---|
| Integration | MRT connection, CDA/CPA/webhook wiring, SSR cache, CSP | - |
| Content types | Schema-as-code definitions + typed React components | Content authoring, Studio operations |
| Environments / locales | Consume per-tier env vars; PWA locale routing | Space setup, environment/alias/locale bootstrap |
| Content ownership | Commerce data (product, price, inventory) | All editorial (banners, modules, lookbooks, footer) |
| Translation | Consume localised entries | Transperfect pipeline (REG-047), Contentful-to-Transperfect direct, no PWA involvement |
| Composed pages (PDP/PLP editorial split, mega-menu tiles) | pending, see §6 item 7 | pending, see §6 item 7 |

## 6. Blockers & dependencies before the squad onboards [Task-6]

| # | Blocker / dependency | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Locale count reconciled to 9 (see §4); `02-contentful.md` §7 still to correct | Jhoan / Integration | Resolved, doc fix pending |
| 2 | MRT env vars per tier not set (`CONTENTFUL_*` + `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`), ops checklist item 4 | Tier-1 approver | Open |
| 3 | Contentful-to-MRT cache-purge webhook not configured (ops item 5) **and** the MRT webhook receiver is not yet in code | Integration | Open |
| 4 | Content-type editing not yet restricted to the CI service account in sit/staging/uat/master (ops item 8) | Integration | Open |
| 5 | CI service-account CMA token not added as a GitHub Actions secret (ops item 9) | Integration | Open |
| 6 | `regions` content-model field unconfirmed (`02-contentful.md` §10.1); affects cross-storefront authoring | Content strategy | Open |
| 7 | Composed-page ownership unconfirmed: which PDP/PLP editorial blocks are Contentful vs SFCC Page Designer, whether category landings are SFCC-routed or Studio Experiences, and whether the mega-menu carries Contentful promo tiles (`02-contentful.md` §10.2) | Tim / Content | Open |
| 8 | Per-environment Contentful credentials to be provided (Space ID, environment ID, CDA + CPA tokens, webhook secret) for Dev/QA/SIT/Stage/UAT/Prod; storefront cannot connect without them ([7.1b Third Party Credentials](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/268337165), status: not yet requested) | Zimmermann IT / Contentful | Open, hard blocker |
| 9 | Product image ownership contradiction: PWA TSD §9 (Performance Strategy) says all imagery incl. product is served from Contentful (`images.ctfassets.net`; DMU-010/CRM-075/HPC-003), but Product TSD §4.3 and §9 say product images load directly into SFCC with no external DAM. Code leans SFCC for product images (the shoppable-image popup pulls them from SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`). The dedicated decision page [DC002 - Product Images Location](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/302186497) exists for exactly this but is currently empty (undecided). Resolve, since it decides whether product imagery is a Contentful concern | Digital / Integration | Open |
| 10 | SSR-first fetch, GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are the documented target but not yet implemented (current hook is browser-side REST); confirm the build sprint | Squad A | Open |

## 7. Key design decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Editorial vs commerce ownership | Contentful editorial-only; SFCC owns product, price, inventory | Single source of truth per domain (Product TSD §6, §9) |
| Content types as code | Schema-as-code + typed component, additive-only sync | Reviewable, drift caught at compile time and in CI (PWA TSD §7.3; `02-contentful.md` §2) |
| Studio Experiences | Drag-and-drop components registered via a separate registration module, definitions generated from the `.tsx` sources | Editors compose pages without a deploy (PWA TSD §7.3) |
| SSR-first content fetch (target) | Server-render editorial for SEO/LCP pages | LCP budget; no CDA call on first paint (currently to build, §6 item 10) |
| Content model rides functional stories | No separate Contentful sprint; the content model for each surface ships with its functional story | `sprintScope.md` |

| 2 | Reconcile the `hotspots` representation between the `shoppableImage` CDA type (Object) and the `shoppable-image` Studio Experience (JSON Text) | Squad A | Open |
| 3 | Confirm whether composed editorial pages use GraphQL (composed) or REST (simple) reads once real content exists | Squad A | Open |

**Spike deliverable, Squad-A**

|  |  |
| --- | --- |

| Reporter | Jasmijn Tsang |

| Last updated | 2026-07-22 |

---

TL;DR
-----

1. **"MRT" is the hosting and proxy layer, not an API.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit Node server. The APIs the storefront actually consumes for product, category, and pricing data are **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached *through* the MRT proxy.
2. **SCAPI can already serve product, category, and pricing today.** The capability exists now: `shopper-products`, `shopper-search`, and pricebook-aware pricing are wired and proven in this codebase. Standalone `shopper-promotions` is available through the base template and is demonstrated here via `expand=promotions`.
3. **The blocker is empty data, not a missing API.** Product and price data are absent from the lower environments because the source-to-SFCC data feeds have not been built yet: product/catalogue is AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC, and price is AP21 to SFCC via XML pricebook import (mechanism, SFTP / API / MuleSoft, still to be confirmed). That is a data-population problem, owned server-side, not an MRT or SCAPI capability gap.
4. **MuleSoft does not serve product or pricing to the PWA.** The direct PWA to MRT to MuleSoft path is only for orders, returns, and real-time boutique stock. Product and price master data is a separate server-to-server import into SFCC.
5. **To unblock lower-environment build and test now:** load catalogue and pricebook data into the `bkzk-002` sandbox (Business Manager or the OCAPI Data API), confirm the BM site, catalogue, and pricebook assignment, then the PWA consumes it via SCAPI with no code change.

---

1. Objective
------------

Document the SFCC MRT (Managed Runtime) APIs relevant to the Zimmermann storefront build, so the squad has a clear picture of what is available for product, pricing, and category data consumption before MuleSoft is ready. This lets the squad determine what can be built and tested in lower environments in the meantime.

2. Background
-------------

* Base Business Manager configuration is in place on the SFCC sandbox, but product and price data are currently missing because MuleSoft is not yet ready.
* Understanding the MRT API capabilities tells the squad what can be built and tested in lower environments while that feed is being built.
* A session is to be set up with M. Ramachandran (owner of SFCC-1, Platform Setup & Environments) to confirm the sandbox data-loading approach.
* The storefront is a PWA Kit application (`zimmermann-pwa`) hosted on Managed Runtime, template-extending `@salesforce/retail-react-app`, consuming commerce data from SFCC and editorial content from Contentful.

3. Tasks and findings
---------------------

### 3.1 Task 1: Review and document the available MRT APIs

**How commerce data reaches the storefront.** The browser talks to SFCC through a proxy hosted by Managed Runtime. Nothing calls SFCC directly from a hard-coded backend host; every call goes through an MRT proxy path, which lets MRT attach server-only credentials and keeps secrets out of the browser bundle.

nonewide760Browser (React, SSR + CSR)
| @salesforce/commerce-sdk-react (TanStack Query under the hood)
v
MRT proxy /mobify/proxy/api --> SCAPI (Shopper APIs): product, category, price, search, promotions, basket, orders, customers
/mobify/proxy/ocapi --> OCAPI (configured; fallback for gaps; not currently called from app code)
/mobify/proxy/mulesoft --> MuleSoft (orders, returns, boutique stock ONLY; designed, not yet wired)
v
SFCC realm (sandbox bkzk-002 in Dev)

The single SDK `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` (v5.2.0) handles every SFCC call: SLAS token lifecycle, retry, and TanStack Query caching. Verified in `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx` (CommerceApiProvider wiring) and consumed via hooks such as `useProduct` and `useProductSearch`.

#### 3.1.1 SCAPI Shopper APIs (primary path for product, category, pricing)

Reached at MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api` (`config/default.js:131`). These are the APIs that serve the data this spike is about.

| API family | Path root | Serves | Verbs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail, master/variant resolution, images, prices on the product | GET |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort, suggestions | GET |
| Shopper Promotions | `/pricing/shopper-promotions/v1/*` | Active promotions, coupon validation | GET |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/checkout/shopper-login/oauth2/*` | Guest and registered auth, token lifecycle | GET, POST |
| Shopper Baskets | `/checkout/shopper-baskets/v2/*` | Basket / cart lifecycle, line items | GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE |
| Shopper Orders | `/checkout/shopper-orders/v1/*` | Order placement and lookup of the just-placed order (SFCC-owned checkouts). Order history and detail come from MuleSoft, not SCAPI (see 3.1.6) | POST, GET |
| Shopper Customers | `/customer/shopper-customers/v1/*` | Profile, addresses, saved-payment references | GET, POST, PATCH |

Source: `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md` section 4.

**Pricing is fully supported through SCAPI.** The canonical query in the codebase (`overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:52-58`) uses `useProductSearch` with `refine: ['cgid=<categoryId>', 'htype=master']` and `expand: ['promotions','variations','prices','images','custom_properties']`, `perPricebook: true`, `allVariationProperties: true`. This demonstrates category refinement plus pricebook-aware pricing and promotion expansion working end to end, given data exists.

#### 3.1.2 Endpoint structure, base URL, and environments

* **SCAPI base host:**`{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com`, proxied via `/mobify/proxy/api`. Verified: `config/default.js:210` host `qmyt7hks.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com`.
* **Instance identifiers** (non-secret; injected from env into the SDK provider at `config/default.js:132-137`):
* `shortCode`: `qmyt7hks`
* `organizationId`: `f_ecom_bkzk_002` (realm/instance `bkzk_002`)
* `siteId`: `ZimmermannAU` (default). The app defines 10 PWA storefront sites backed by 7 distinct SFCC sites (the four EU-domestic locales share SFCC site `ZimmermannEU`); see `config/sites.overlay.js`.
* `clientId`: SLAS client ID (public identifier, held in `COMMERCE_API_CLIENT_ID`)
* **Per-environment config:**`config/dev.js`, `test.js`, `sit.js`, `staging.js`, `uat.js`, `production.js` each override `proxyConfigs`. The SCAPI host stays constant (`qmyt7hks...`); the OCAPI host changes per tier (Dev to `bkzk-002.dx...`, Prod to `production-ap01-zimmermann.demandware.net`).
* **Env switching:**`npm run env -- <tier>` (`scripts/switchEnv.mjs`); deploy per tier via `npm run push:<tier>`, which runs `pwa-kit-dev push -t <target>`.
* MRT environment variables are managed per environment in the Managed Runtime console and rotated independently of the codebase (Confluence: Technical Solution Design, PWA).

#### 3.1.3 Authentication

* **SLAS private-client flow** issues a guest access token (anonymous shopper, refreshed silently) and a registered shopper token (after email/password login). Tokens are JWTs carrying customer ID, unique shopper ID (USID), and a refresh token.
* **Secrets stay server-side.** The SLAS client secret is an MRT environment variable and never reaches the browser; the authorisation-code exchange is proxied through the MRT private-client endpoint. The SLAS client ID and SCAPI short code remain in the bundle as public identifiers. Confirmed in `overrides/app/ssr.js:52` (`useSLASPrivateClient: true`) and `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx:132,147-148`.
* **Refresh tokens** live in `httpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict` cookies set by the SSR layer; browser JavaScript never sees the raw refresh token.
* **Multi-site tokens are channel-scoped.** A token for one site is not valid for another; a storefront switch triggers a fresh server-side authorisation (SLAS Trusted System on Behalf).

Source: `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md` section 3.

#### 3.1.4 Payload format and query conventions

* **Format:** JSON over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+), standard SCAPI response envelopes.
* **Every request carries** site ID, organisation ID, locale, currency, and the SLAS bearer token.
* **Efficiency levers used:**`expand=` to pull promotions/variations/prices/images in one call; `fields=` projection to trim payloads; `perPricebook: true` for pricebook-aware pricing; TanStack Query dedup and caching (documented working targets: catalogue stale time ~60s, promotions ~30s, basket 0s, per `01-sfcc.md` section 6; the app-level default `staleTime` is 10s).

#### 3.1.5 OCAPI (configured proxy; not currently consumed in app code)

* A proxy path `/mobify/proxy/ocapi` is configured (`config/default.js:213-216`, Dev host `bkzk-002.dx.commercecloud.salesforce.com`) so that any operation not covered by SCAPI can be proxied through MRT with OCAPI credentials held server-side. No OCAPI credentials ever reach the browser.
* Current state: OCAPI is **not called from application code**; it is referenced only in host-validation and sync tooling (`scripts/switchEnv.mjs`, `scripts/sfcc/*.mjs`). It is a configured capability held in reserve, not an active runtime dependency.
* Note the distinction from the import channel below: the **admin OCAPI Data API** used to load catalogue data (3.1.8) is a separate, admin-authenticated channel, not the shopper-facing `/mobify/proxy/ocapi` storefront proxy.

#### 3.1.6 MuleSoft-direct reads via MRT (not product, category, or pricing)

There is a designed direct path `PWA to MRT to MuleSoft` at `/mobify/proxy/mulesoft/...` for a small set of reads where SFCC adds nothing to the round-trip. It is **scaffolded but not yet wired**: no `mulesoft` entry exists in any `config/*.js`, and the intended mechanism is a server-side `fetch()` from `ssr.js` over a dedicated undici connection pool (`overrides/app/ssr/connectionPools.ts:42-46`, `mulesoftPool`), not a PWA Kit `proxyConfig`. A plain proxyConfig would not suffice, because this path must inject `client_id`/`client_secret` request headers and a session-derived `customer_id` that proxyConfigs cannot add.

In scope for this path: order history list, order detail, returns, real-time boutique stock (Find in Boutique / BOPIS), GiveX balance check. **Product, category, and pricing are explicitly out of scope for this path.** Source: `.docs/integration/03-mulesoft.md`.

#### 3.1.7 Einstein recommendations (adjacent capability)

Personalised recommendations use the Einstein API (`config/default.js:140-148`, host `https://api.cquotient.com`), consent-gated, with a static SFCC merchandising-group fallback. Not part of the core product/category/pricing consumption but available through the same app.

#### 3.1.8 Catalogue and pricebook population path (server-to-server, the missing piece)

This is what "MuleSoft is not yet ready" refers to, and it is not an MRT capability at all:

* **Product:** AP21 (ERP, system of record) to MuleSoft (transform to SFCC Catalog XML) to SFCC, delivered via the **admin OCAPI Data API** (`/s/-/dw/data/v*/catalogs`) or SFTP + import job. Per the Confluence TSD, a master catalogue plus per-site storefront catalogues.
* **Price:** AP21 to SFCC pricebooks, per-site and per-currency, loaded as SFCC Pricebook XML (`pricebook.xsd`). Per the TSD, **there is no direct MuleSoft price integration today**; the delivery mechanism (SFTP / API / MuleSoft) is still to be confirmed (TSD Price open item 1). Pricebook IDs follow `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` and `{site}-{currency}-sale-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`, `au-aud-sale-prices`; sale pricebook parents the list pricebook). Import via `sfcc-ci instance:import` or Business Manager Site Import.
* Product IDs (per TSD): master = `stylecode` (e.g. `4673TS251`); variant = `stylecode + colourcode + sizecode`.
* The master-catalogue-to-storefront-category assignment is set in Business Manager and cannot be set via XML import.
* **Catalogue ID caveat:** the TSD names the master as `zimmermann-catalog` and storefront catalogues as `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`. The PWA repo does not contain SFCC catalogue configuration (that lives in the SFCC cartridge repo), so these IDs are expected to be absent here; that absence is not a contradiction. The only similar-looking value in the repo, `storefront-catalog-eu`, is the `shop.id` field inside a sample MuleSoft order-response payload (`.docs/vendor/mulesoft.md`), not an SFCC catalogue definition. Confirm the actual sandbox catalogue IDs with M. Ramachandran before using them for BM configuration.

Source: Confluence "TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration" and "TSD: Price, SFCC Pricebooks & Global-e".

### 3.2 Task 2: Which MRT APIs can serve product, category, and pricing in lower environments now

**Answer: SCAPI can, as soon as data exists in the sandbox.** The API capability is not the constraint. `shopper-products`, `shopper-search` (with `cgid` category refinement), and pricebook-aware pricing via `expand=prices` with `perPricebook=true` all work against any populated SFCC instance.

The only thing missing in the lower environments is **data in the SFCC catalogue and pricebooks**. Once data is loaded (see section 4), front-end development and testing can proceed against SCAPI with no dependency on the upstream data feeds being finished.

| Capability | Available in lower env now? | Depends on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Product detail (`shopper-products`) | Yes, once catalogue data is loaded | Sandbox catalogue populated |
| Category listing / search (`shopper-search`, `cgid`) | Yes, once catalogue + storefront categories + search index exist | BM catalogue assignment + search index rebuild |
| Pricing (`prices`, `perPricebook`) | Yes, once pricebooks are loaded and assigned | Sandbox pricebooks populated + assigned to site |
| Promotions (`shopper-promotions`) | Yes, once promotions are configured in BM | BM promotion setup |
| Auth (SLAS) | Yes, working now | SLAS client already configured |

### 3.3 Task 3: Limitations and gaps to be covered by MuleSoft (or elsewhere)

* **No catalogue or price data in the sandbox** until either sample/manual data is loaded or the source-to-SFCC product and price feeds are built (dependency: SFCC-121).
* **Catalogue/price freshness and delta handling** (event vs scheduled, sale-price removal signals) are data-feed concerns, not SCAPI concerns.
* **MuleSoft real-time rate limits** for the direct-read path are unconfirmed (Confluence "MuleSoft Integration, Open Questions", item G3).
* **Delivery mechanism for catalogue import** (OCAPI Data API vs SFTP + import job) and the feed trigger are still open (Confluence TSD Product, open item 1).
* **Per-environment SLAS client ID / short code** for non-Dev tiers partly outstanding (`.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md` section 7).
* The **MuleSoft direct-read path** (`/mobify/proxy/mulesoft`) is not yet wired, so order history, returns, and boutique stock are not consumable from the PWA until it is added and MuleSoft endpoints are provisioned per environment.

### 3.4 Task 4: Permanent architecture vs current-state workaround

| Element | Classification | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCAPI via MRT proxy for product / category / pricing consumption | **Permanent** | The storefront's supported model for all shopper data |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** | Standard PWA Kit pattern |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC product/catalogue feed (population) | **Permanent** | The intended catalogue data source; not yet built |
| AP21 to SFCC price feed via pricebook XML import (population) | **Permanent** | No direct MuleSoft price integration per TSD; mechanism (SFTP / API / MuleSoft) to be confirmed; not yet built |
| OCAPI via MRT for operations SCAPI does not cover | **Permanent (semi)** | Configured fallback by design; currently unused; shrinks as SCAPI coverage grows |
| PWA to MRT to MuleSoft direct reads (orders, returns, boutique stock) | **Permanent** | Designed, not yet wired |
| Manual / sample catalogue and pricebook load into the sandbox | **Workaround** | Current-state only, to unblock lower-env build and test before the permanent product and price feeds exist |

4. Recommended actions to unblock lower environments
----------------------------------------------------

1. **Load catalogue and pricebook data into the** `bkzk-002` **sandbox.** Options, in order of preference for a quick unblock: - Import a sample/seed catalogue via the **admin OCAPI Data API** (`/s/-/dw/data/v*/catalogs`) or a site-archive import job in Business Manager. - Load pricebooks as SFCC Pricebook XML via `sfcc-ci instance:import` or Business Manager Site Import; IDs follow `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` / `-sale-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`). - Note: the catalogue/data tooling and sample data are **not in** `zimmermann-pwa` (the PWA repo only consumes). Per the TSD, the conversion/seed tooling is assumed to live in a separate SFCC cartridge repo (referred to as `zimmermann-sfccworkplace`); confirm the repo name, ownership, and access with M. Ramachandran.
2. **Confirm Business Manager configuration** on the sandbox: site catalogue assignment (catalogue IDs to be confirmed against the sandbox, see the caveat in 3.1.8), storefront category tree, pricebook assignment per site/currency, and a search index rebuild so `shopper-search` returns results.
3. **Verify SCAPI reachability** from the sandbox with a SLAS guest token and a `shopper-search` smoke test, to confirm data is queryable before front-end work starts.
4. **Front-end proceeds via** `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` hooks against the populated sandbox: no code change is needed once data exists.
5. **Track the permanent feeds** (SFCC-121) separately; the workaround load is throwaway once the permanent product and price feeds are delivering.

5. Definition of Done: status
-----------------------------

> **DoD:** A documented inventory of relevant MRT APIs is produced and shared with the squad, sufficient to unblock BM configuration and front-end development in lower environments.

| DoD element | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Inventory of relevant MRT/SCAPI APIs (endpoints, structure, payload, auth, data) | Done, section 3.1 |
| Assessment of what can serve product/category/pricing in lower envs | Done, section 3.2 |
| Limitations and gaps for MuleSoft to cover | Done, section 3.3 |
| Permanent vs workaround classification | Done, section 3.4 |
| Actions sufficient to unblock front-end dev | Done, section 4 (proven SDK/hook path; no code change once data exists) |
| Actions sufficient to unblock BM config | Partial, section 4; the exact catalogue IDs and current sandbox data state are open questions for M. Ramachandran (section 6) |
| Shared with the squad | Pending: this draft to be reviewed, then published to Confluence |

6. Open questions
-----------------

1. What product / category / price data (if any) is currently loaded in the `bkzk-002` sandbox, and how did it get there?
2. What are the actual catalogue IDs on the sandbox (master and per-site storefront)? The TSD names them `zimmermann-catalog` and `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`; please confirm these are correct for the sandbox.
3. Who owns the SFCC cartridge repo and the sample/seed catalogue data, and can we get access to run an import?
4. Preferred sandbox load mechanism for the interim: OCAPI Data API, BM site-archive import, or manual BM entry?
5. Is the base BM config (site catalogue assignment, pricebook assignment, search index) already complete on the sandbox, or is any of it outstanding?
6. Confirmed delivery mechanism and trigger for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue and price feed (ties to SFCC-121).

import re, pathlib

def declutter(s):
    # remove the draft-banner warning emoji + variation selector
    s = s.replace("⚠️ ", "").replace("⚠️", "").replace("️", "")
    # remove the status dot
    s = s.replace("🟡 ", "").replace("🟡", "")
    # nicer text for the ticked "Exists in code?" cells
    specific = {
        "✅ Studio Exp `collection-hero`": "Yes (Studio Exp `collection-hero`)",
        "✅ Studio Exp `image-text`": "Yes (Studio Exp `image-text`)",
        "✅ Studio Exp + CDA type `shoppableImage`": "Yes (Studio Exp + CDA type `shoppableImage`)",
        "✅ component only": "Yes (component only)",
    }
    for a, b in specific.items():
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    # any stragglers
    s = s.replace("❌", "No").replace("✅", "Yes")
    return s

def emoji_left(s):

31	## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]
