33	**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.
34	
35	```
36	PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
37	   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
38	   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
39	   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
40	   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
41	   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
42	```
43	
44	| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
45	|---|---|---|---|
46	| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
47	| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
48	| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
49	| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

51	CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.

# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. > **Status:** In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). ## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

      "value": "Overview
--------

Editorial and CMS content in the Zimmermann SFCC platform is owned by Contentful and managed by the Zimmermann content team. MRT (Managed Runtime — Salesforce's PWA hosting layer) acts as the integration layer between Contentful and the browser-rendered PWA storefront.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Direction** | **Flow** |
| Inbound (Contentful → MRT) | Published content entries (hero banners, editorial modules, navigation, footer, announcement banners, size guides, accordion copy) delivered via the Contentful Delivery API (CDA) to the MRT SSR layer on every page render. |
| Outbound (MRT → Contentful) | Cache-purge webhook acknowledgements; Management API calls from CI for schema migrations. No content flows from SFCC back to Contentful. |
| NOT in this flow | SFCC does not connect to Contentful directly. All CMS content is fetched by the MRT Node layer, not by SFCC cartridges or Business Manager. |

*Contentful is the sole CMS for all eight Zimmermann storefronts. SFCC manages commerce data (products, pricing, orders); Contentful manages editorial data (copy, imagery configuration, page layouts). They complement each other without overlap.*

Integration Architecture & Data Flow
------------------------------------

**Pattern:** Contentful → MRT (Node/SSR) → browser, SSR-first for SEO/LCP.

### Architecture diagram

wide760PWA (SSR layer, then CSR hydration)
│
├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA) — published content
│ SSR fetches server-side; browser also uses CDA on
│ post-hydration reads. Public token, safe in bundle.
│
├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA) — draft content
│ Editor preview only. Token held server-side in MRT;
│ never reaches the browser. Requests proxied through
│ an MRT preview endpoint.
│
├──► Contentful Images API (images.ctfassets.net)
│ srcset / sizes / avif|webp / quality parameters
│
└──◄ Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful
Clears affected SSR cache keys on entry publish.
HMAC-verified with a shared secret.

### **API surface & token boundary**

| Surface | Origin / Boundary | Token | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first; browser hydrates from SSR payload. Safe to embed in bundle. |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Editor preview via iframe `postMessage`. Never reaches browser. |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI host only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT/bundle — build-time only. Never embedded, never in PR diffs. |
| Publish webhook | Contentful → MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Clears SSR cache keys on publish. TTL fallback 60s SWR. Rejected and logged if HMAC fails. |

**Key behaviours confirmed in** `02-contentful.md`**:**

* **SSR first.** Editorial content for SEO- and LCP-critical pages (homepage, PLP, PDP, campaign landings) is fetched server-side. The browser hydrates from the SSR payload — no CDA call on first paint.
* **GraphQL for composed pages.** Where a page assembles many entries, the storefront uses the GraphQL Content API to fetch only the needed fields in one request. REST CDA is used for simpler reads.
* **Live preview.** When an editor opens preview in Contentful Studio, the storefront renders inside Studio's iframe. It detects the preview origin, switches to the CPA-backed MRT proxy, and refreshes on `postMessage` events from Studio.
* **Asset delivery.** Images come from `images.ctfassets.net`. The storefront generates `srcset`, `sizes`, AVIF with WebP fallback, and quality parameters per breakpoint. `images.ctfassets.net` is preconnected from the document head.
* **SSR cache TTL.** 60 seconds with stale-while-revalidate. Publish webhooks clear the cache — the TTL is the fallback if a webhook drops.
* **CDN rate limit.** 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token. The SSR cache absorbs almost all traffic — risk only during burst republish events.
* **Bundle weight.** Rich-text renderer is dynamically imported only on pages that use rich-text fields.
* **No PII** flows through Contentful.

### Content Ownership (from 02-contentful.md)

SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. On pages that mix both, editorial comes from Contentful and commerce data is resolved from SFCC. Product and category references in Contentful entries are authored via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and resolved at render (HPC-001).

| **Surface** | **SFCC Owns** | **Contentful Owns** | **Status** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Homepage | Commerce data for embedded product refs | All modules — hero, banners, campaign blocks | Confirmed |
| Campaign landing pages | Commerce data for embedded product refs | Full page (Contentful Studio Experiences) | Confirmed |
| Lookbooks | Commerce data for shop-the-look refs | Imagery, layout, copy | Confirmed |
| Size guides | — | Fallback content only. Primary size guide is Measmerize overlay (PRD-053). Contentful serves size guide content only where no Measmerize data exists. | Confirmed |
| Footer | — | All content | Confirmed |
| PLP / category | Category results, product tiles, facets, pagination, hero/banner and editorial rows (SFCC BM — SPR-03/04/64) | Contentful-authored editorial rows, if any | Pending — whether any PLP editorial comes from Contentful |
| PDP | Product attributes, price, inventory, variations, gallery | Marketing copy, editorial blocks, size guide fallback (primary is Measmerize — PRD-053) | Pending — which blocks are Contentful vs SFCC Page Designer |
| Navigation / mega-menu | Category tree | Promotional tiles, if any | Pending |
| Product badges | Badge labels and taxonomy — managed in SFCC BM product attributes (PRD-005) | — | Confirmed — Contentful is not the source of badge content |

### Error Handling & Monitoring

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Scenario** | **Handling** |
| Contentful CDA unavailable during SSR | Render the page without editorial content. Log the error. Commerce data (SFCC) is unaffected. NEVER block the page render on CMS availability. |
| Contentful entry field is null or missing | Component must handle gracefully with a null-safe default. No uncaught exceptions from missing CMS data. |
| Invalid HMAC on incoming webhook | Return 401 immediately. Do not process. Log the attempt. |
| Schema drift detected in CI gate | CI exits non-zero. Deploy is blocked. Developer must run npm run migrate:contentful to resolve before re-triggering. |
| Migration script fails mid-run | Contentful does not roll back automatically. Developer must assess partial state and write a compensating migration. Coordinate with content editors. |
| Preview API accessed from browser | Should be architecturally impossible — CPA is MRT server-side only. If a browser request reaches CPA, treat as a security incident. |
| Consent gating failure (Didomi) | Fail closed: no third-party scripts load. Affects Vimeo embeds in editorial content. See SFCC-106. |

Graceful degradation is non-negotiable: Contentful being unavailable must never break the commerce experience. Commerce data (products, pricing, basket, checkout) and CMS editorial content are fetched independently.

Detailed Reference: Contentful CMS — Setup & Operations

### Six-Tier Delivery Pipeline

One Contentful Space, one Environment per delivery tier. Environments are fully isolated. Promotion is always sequential — no tier skipping.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Tier** | **Name** | **Contentful Env ID** | **MRT Push Command** | **Purpose** |
| 1 & 2 | DEV | dev | npm run push:dev | Feature development and integration testing |
| 3 | TEST | test | npm run push:test | Digital QA (being created) |
| 4 | OMS INT (SIT) | sit | npm run push:sit | NewStore SIT regression |
| 5 | STAGE | staging | npm run push:staging | Full E2E with live third parties |
| 6 | UAT | uat | npm run push:uat | Business acceptance across all regions |
| 7 | PRODUCTION | master (via production alias) | npm run push:prod | Live customer-facing production |

### Production Alias Strategy — Zero-Downtime Releases

Production MRT uses CONTENTFUL\_ENVIRONMENT\_ID=production, which resolves to a Contentful alias, not a fixed environment name. Flipping the alias is how zero-downtime releases are performed.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Step** | **Action** | **Command** |
| 1 | Clone production environment for the release. | Contentful UI → Space Settings → Environments → Clone |
| 2 | Run migrations against the release clone. | npm run migrate:contentful -- --target release-YYYY-MM |
| 3 | Test directly against the release env (bypasses alias). | CONTENTFUL\_ENVIRONMENT\_ID=release-YYYY-MM npm start |
| 4 | Promote: flip production and master aliases atomically. | npm run promote:alias -- --target release-YYYY-MM |
| 5 | Keep previous environment 14 days as rollback target, then delete. | Contentful UI → Space Settings → Environments → Delete |

*The production alias requires the Contentful Enterprise plan. Confirm with Zimmermann that the Enterprise plan is active before the first production release.*

### Locale Rules for Content Modellers

* Translatable fields (headline, body copy, CTA text, alt text) → set localized: true in the content type definition.
* Structural fields (asset links, layout flags, product IDs) → set localized: false — shared across all locales.
* Fallback chain: if a locale (e.g. fr) has no content for a field, Contentful falls back to en automatically. Authors only fill fields they want to override.
* Translation pipeline: Transperfect is the translation partner (HPC-006). Strategy is under discussion — Contentful squad to own.

Key Design Decisions
--------------------

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Decision** | **Choice** | **Rationale** |
| Single Contentful Space for all 8 storefronts | One Space, per-locale content fields | Locale model handles per-storefront variation. Avoids content duplication and reduces operational overhead vs one space per storefront. |
| Schema as code — not hand-created in UI | Git-managed definitions deployed via npm run sync:contentful | Prevents schema drift, enables code review of content model changes, and gives CI visibility of structural changes before production. |
| CDA token in browser bundle (delivery only) | Delivery API token is browser-safe | CDA tokens are read-only and scoped to one environment. Preview (CPA) and Management (CMA) tokens are never deployed to MRT or exposed to the browser. |
| Production alias instead of fixed environment name | CONTENTFUL\_ENVIRONMENT\_ID=production resolves to an alias | Enables zero-downtime releases: flip the alias to a pre-tested release clone without redeploying MRT. Requires Contentful Enterprise plan. |
| ISR cache invalidation via webhook on publish | Contentful fires HMAC-signed webhook → MRT invalidates cache | Pages are server-rendered and cached. Without cache invalidation, published content changes would not appear until cache TTL expires. Webhook makes updates near-real-time. |
| Graceful degradation for CMS unavailability | Render page without editorial content if Contentful is down | Commerce functionality must never be blocked by CMS availability. Editorial content is an enhancement, not a dependency. |
| Contentful SDK v11 — no connection pool isolation hook | Mitigate via graceful degradation, not pool isolation | SDK v11 does not expose a dispatcher hook for custom connection pooling. Primary mitigation is graceful degradation. |

# Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

## Overview

Editorial and CMS content in the Zimmermann SFCC platform is owned by Contentful and managed by the Zimmermann content team. MRT (Managed Runtime, Salesforce's PWA hosting layer) acts as the integration layer between Contentful and the browser-rendered PWA storefront.

| Direction | Flow |
| --- | --- |
| Inbound (Contentful to MRT) | Published content entries (hero banners, editorial modules, navigation, footer, announcement banners, size guides, accordion copy) delivered via the Contentful Delivery API (CDA) to the MRT SSR layer on every page render. |
| Outbound (MRT to Contentful) | Cache-purge webhook acknowledgements; Management API calls from CI for schema migrations. No content flows from SFCC back to Contentful. |
| NOT in this flow | SFCC does not connect to Contentful directly. All CMS content is fetched by the MRT Node layer, not by SFCC cartridges or Business Manager. |

Contentful is the sole CMS for all eight Zimmermann storefronts. SFCC manages commerce data (products, pricing, orders); Contentful manages editorial data (copy, imagery configuration, page layouts). They complement each other without overlap.

## Integration Architecture & Data Flow

Pattern: Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO/LCP.

Architecture diagram: PWA (SSR layer, then CSR hydration) with CDA (published content, SSR fetches server-side; browser also uses CDA on post-hydration reads; public token safe in bundle), CPA (draft content, editor preview only, token server-side in MRT, proxied through an MRT preview endpoint), Contentful Images API (images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes/avif|webp), and Publish webhook to MRT /webhooks/contentful (clears affected SSR cache keys on entry publish, HMAC-verified).

### API surface & token boundary

| Surface | Origin / Boundary | Token | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN (public, read-only) | SSR-first; browser hydrates from SSR payload. Safe to embed in bundle. |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN (server-side) | Editor preview via iframe postMessage. Never reaches browser. |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI host only | CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN | Never in MRT/bundle, build-time only. Never embedded, never in PR diffs. |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET (HMAC) | Clears SSR cache keys on publish. TTL fallback 60s SWR. Rejected and logged if HMAC fails. |

Key behaviours confirmed in 02-contentful.md:
- SSR first. Editorial content for SEO- and LCP-critical pages (homepage, PLP, PDP, campaign landings) is fetched server-side. The browser hydrates from the SSR payload, no CDA call on first paint.
- GraphQL for composed pages. Where a page assembles many entries, the storefront uses the GraphQL Content API to fetch only the needed fields in one request. REST CDA is used for simpler reads.
- Live preview. When an editor opens preview in Contentful Studio, the storefront renders inside Studio's iframe. It detects the preview origin, switches to the CPA-backed MRT proxy, and refreshes on postMessage events from Studio.
- Asset delivery. Images come from images.ctfassets.net. The storefront generates srcset, sizes, AVIF with WebP fallback, and quality parameters per breakpoint. images.ctfassets.net is preconnected from the document head.
- SSR cache TTL. 60 seconds with stale-while-revalidate. Publish webhooks clear the cache, the TTL is the fallback if a webhook drops.
- CDN rate limit. 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token. The SSR cache absorbs almost all traffic, risk only during burst republish events.
- Bundle weight. Rich-text renderer is dynamically imported only on pages that use rich-text fields.
- No PII flows through Contentful.

### Content Ownership (from 02-contentful.md)

SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. On pages that mix both, editorial comes from Contentful and commerce data is resolved from SFCC. Product and category references in Contentful entries are authored via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and resolved at render (HPC-001).

| Surface | SFCC Owns | Contentful Owns | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Homepage | Commerce data for embedded product refs | All modules, hero, banners, campaign blocks | Confirmed |
| Campaign landing pages | Commerce data for embedded product refs | Full page (Contentful Studio Experiences) | Confirmed |
| Lookbooks | Commerce data for shop-the-look refs | Imagery, layout, copy | Confirmed |
| Size guides | - | Fallback content only. Primary size guide is Measmerize overlay (PRD-053). | Confirmed |
| Footer | - | All content | Confirmed |
| PLP / category | Category results, product tiles, facets, pagination, hero/banner and editorial rows (SFCC BM, SPR-03/04/64) | Contentful-authored editorial rows, if any | Pending |
| PDP | Product attributes, price, inventory, variations, gallery | Marketing copy, editorial blocks, size guide fallback (primary is Measmerize, PRD-053) | Pending |
| Navigation / mega-menu | Category tree | Promotional tiles, if any | Pending |
| Product badges | Badge labels and taxonomy, managed in SFCC BM product attributes (PRD-005) | - | Confirmed |

## Content Model Requirements

### SPRINT 1 Content Types, Required Now

Derived from active and blocked Jira stories. Each type requires a TypeScript React component in overrides/ and a schema definition in scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js.

### What is NOT in Contentful

Do not model these in Contentful, owned by other systems:
- Product data (names, descriptions, pricing, stock), AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC
- Product imagery, SFCC Business Manager static content library
- Orders, customer data, basket, SFCC / NewStore / Omneo
- Tax rules, pricebooks, checkout configuration, SFCC Business Manager
- GTM tags, analytics configuration, Tell No Lies

### Error Handling & Monitoring

| Scenario | Handling |
| --- | --- |
| Contentful CDA unavailable during SSR | Render the page without editorial content. Log the error. Commerce data (SFCC) is unaffected. NEVER block the page render on CMS availability. |
| Contentful entry field is null or missing | Component must handle gracefully with a null-safe default. No uncaught exceptions from missing CMS data. |
| Invalid HMAC on incoming webhook | Return 401 immediately. Do not process. Log the attempt. |
| Schema drift detected in CI gate | CI exits non-zero. Deploy is blocked. Developer must run npm run migrate:contentful before re-triggering. |
| Migration script fails mid-run | Contentful does not roll back automatically. Developer must assess partial state and write a compensating migration. |
| Preview API accessed from browser | Should be architecturally impossible, CPA is MRT server-side only. If a browser request reaches CPA, treat as a security incident. |
| Consent gating failure (Didomi) | Fail closed: no third-party scripts load. Affects Vimeo embeds in editorial content. See SFCC-106. |

Graceful degradation is non-negotiable: Contentful being unavailable must never break the commerce experience.

## Environment & Locale Configuration

Detailed reference: Contentful CMS, Setup & Operations.

### Six-Tier Delivery Pipeline

One Contentful Space, one Environment per delivery tier. Promotion is always sequential.

| Tier | Name | Contentful Env ID | MRT Push Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 & 2 | DEV | dev | npm run push:dev | Feature development and integration testing |
| 3 | TEST | test | npm run push:test | Digital QA (being created) |
| 4 | OMS INT (SIT) | sit | npm run push:sit | NewStore SIT regression |
| 5 | STAGE | staging | npm run push:staging | Full E2E with live third parties |
| 6 | UAT | uat | npm run push:uat | Business acceptance across all regions |
| 7 | PRODUCTION | master (via production alias) | npm run push:prod | Live customer-facing production |

### Production Alias Strategy, Zero-Downtime Releases

Production MRT uses CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT_ID=production, which resolves to a Contentful alias. Flipping the alias is how zero-downtime releases are performed. Steps: clone production env for the release; run migrations against the clone (npm run migrate:contentful -- --target release-YYYY-MM); test directly against the release env; promote by flipping production and master aliases atomically (npm run promote:alias -- --target release-YYYY-MM); keep previous env 14 days as rollback then delete. The production alias requires the Contentful Enterprise plan.

# Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

## Overview

Editorial and CMS content in the Zimmermann SFCC platform is owned by Contentful and managed by the Zimmermann content team. MRT (Managed Runtime, Salesforce's PWA hosting layer) acts as the integration layer between Contentful and the browser-rendered PWA storefront.

| Direction | Flow |
| --- | --- |
| Inbound (Contentful to MRT) | Published content entries (hero banners, editorial modules, navigation, footer, announcement banners, size guides, accordion copy) delivered via the Contentful Delivery API (CDA) to the MRT SSR layer on every page render. |
| Outbound (MRT to Contentful) | Cache-purge webhook acknowledgements; Management API calls from CI for schema migrations. No content flows from SFCC back to Contentful. |
| NOT in this flow | SFCC does not connect to Contentful directly. All CMS content is fetched by the MRT Node layer, not by SFCC cartridges or Business Manager. |

Contentful is the sole CMS for all eight Zimmermann storefronts. SFCC manages commerce data (products, pricing, orders); Contentful manages editorial data (copy, imagery configuration, page layouts). They complement each other without overlap.

## Integration Architecture & Data Flow

Pattern: Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO/LCP.

Architecture diagram: PWA (SSR layer, then CSR hydration) with CDA (published content, SSR fetches server-side; browser also uses CDA on post-hydration reads; public token safe in bundle), CPA (draft content, editor preview only, token server-side in MRT, proxied through an MRT preview endpoint), Contentful Images API (images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes/avif|webp), and Publish webhook to MRT /webhooks/contentful (clears affected SSR cache keys on entry publish, HMAC-verified).

### API surface & token boundary

| Surface | Origin / Boundary | Token | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN (public, read-only) | SSR-first; browser hydrates from SSR payload. Safe to embed in bundle. |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN (server-side) | Editor preview via iframe postMessage. Never reaches browser. |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI host only | CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN | Never in MRT/bundle, build-time only. Never embedded, never in PR diffs. |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET (HMAC) | Clears SSR cache keys on publish. TTL fallback 60s SWR. Rejected and logged if HMAC fails. |

Key behaviours confirmed in 02-contentful.md:
- SSR first. Editorial content for SEO- and LCP-critical pages (homepage, PLP, PDP, campaign landings) is fetched server-side. The browser hydrates from the SSR payload, no CDA call on first paint.
- GraphQL for composed pages. Where a page assembles many entries, the storefront uses the GraphQL Content API to fetch only the needed fields in one request. REST CDA is used for simpler reads.
- Live preview. When an editor opens preview in Contentful Studio, the storefront renders inside Studio's iframe. It detects the preview origin, switches to the CPA-backed MRT proxy, and refreshes on postMessage events from Studio.
- Asset delivery. Images come from images.ctfassets.net. The storefront generates srcset, sizes, AVIF with WebP fallback, and quality parameters per breakpoint. images.ctfassets.net is preconnected from the document head.
- SSR cache TTL. 60 seconds with stale-while-revalidate. Publish webhooks clear the cache, the TTL is the fallback if a webhook drops.
- CDN rate limit. 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token. The SSR cache absorbs almost all traffic, risk only during burst republish events.
- Bundle weight. Rich-text renderer is dynamically imported only on pages that use rich-text fields.
- No PII flows through Contentful.

### Content Ownership (from 02-contentful.md)

SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. On pages that mix both, editorial comes from Contentful and commerce data is resolved from SFCC. Product and category references in Contentful entries are authored via the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app and resolved at render (HPC-001).

| Lookbooks | Commerce data for shop-the-look refs | Imagery, layout, copy | Confirmed |
| Size guides | - | Fallback content only. Primary size guide is Measmerize overlay (PRD-053). | Confirmed |
| Footer | - | All content | Confirmed |
| PLP / category | Category results, product tiles, facets, pagination, hero/banner and editorial rows (SFCC BM, SPR-03/04/64) | Contentful-authored editorial rows, if any | Pending |

### Error Handling & Monitoring

| Scenario | Handling |
| --- | --- |
| Contentful CDA unavailable during SSR | Render the page without editorial content. Log the error. Commerce data (SFCC) is unaffected. NEVER block the page render on CMS availability. |

| Invalid HMAC on incoming webhook | Return 401 immediately. Do not process. Log the attempt. |
| Schema drift detected in CI gate | CI exits non-zero. Deploy is blocked. Developer must run npm run migrate:contentful before re-triggering. |
| Migration script fails mid-run | Contentful does not roll back automatically. Developer must assess partial state and write a compensating migration. |
| Preview API accessed from browser | Should be architecturally impossible, CPA is MRT server-side only. If a browser request reaches CPA, treat as a security incident. |
| Consent gating failure (Didomi) | Fail closed: no third-party scripts load. Affects Vimeo embeds in editorial content. See SFCC-106. |

I have completed my independent verification. Here is my adjudication.

---

## Code verification results (ground truth confirmed in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`)

Every check confirmed the neutral facts and settled the disputed claims:
- `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` — **browser-side REST**. Two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) using `useState`/`useEffect` + `fetch` to `cdn.contentful.com`/`preview.contentful.com` with `include=2`. **No SSR-first fetch, no GraphQL.**
- **No publish-webhook receiver anywhere** in `overrides/` or `scripts/` (grep for webhook/HMAC returned nothing). No `graphql.contentful.com` client; the only `createClient` calls are the REST `contentful` SDK (experience route) and `contentful-management` (CMA scripts).
- `experiences/definitions.ts` — **exactly 3 Studio Experiences**: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- `scripts/contentful/content-types/` — **exactly 1 CDA content type**: `shoppableImage.js`.
- `config/sites.overlay.js` — **10 PWA sites, 9 distinct Contentful locales** (`en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`, `fr`, `it`, `es`, `en-CH`, `en-HK`, `en-AE`). `contentfulMapping.generated.ts` `SUPPORTED_LOCALES` matches those 9 exactly; `DEFAULT_LOCALE = 'en'`; `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD = 'productId'`; `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENTS` exists. `sites.generated.js` lists `en-AU` as AU's BM defaultLocale (overlay narrows to `en`).
- `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves product images from **SFCC via `useProduct` (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) + `disBaseLink`** — corroborating that product imagery leans SFCC, not Contentful.
- npm scripts referenced by BOTH drafts exist (`push:dev…push:prod`, `sync:contentful`, `setup:contentful`, `migrate:contentful`, `promote:alias`, `detect:drift`, `generate:contentful`, `sync:regional-config`). `contentful` dep is `^11.12.4` (Draft ONE's "SDK v11" is accurate).

The net: **Draft TWO's code claims are accurate to the line; Draft ONE describes the target architecture as if it were the current build.**

---

## 1. Per-draft scorecard (A–H)

| Axis | Draft ONE | Draft TWO |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Architecture accuracy** | **2/5** — Correct target, but states SSR-first/GraphQL/webhook as *current* reality; never discloses the live layer is browser-side REST. | **5/5** — Explicit "current vs target" callout; browser-side REST reality documented precisely and verified true. |
| **B. Content-model completeness (S1/S2)** | **2.5/5** — Broadest type list, but mis-assigns Sprint 4 (checkout) and Sprint 7 (returns) content to Sprint 2, treats 3 epics as stories, and omits the two live experiences. | **4.5/5** — Correct S1/S2 scoping, correct backing-story IDs *and* statuses, UI-vs-content split (SFCC-82/203, 190/204), grounded in actual code. |
| **C. SFCC consumption detail** | **3/5** — Rich fields/rendering + error matrix + dev setup, but field sets are aspirational (only `shoppableImage` exists). | **4/5** — Accurate capability table with build status; verified `shoppableImage` field reference and concrete SCAPI product-resolution pattern. |
| **D. Locale correctness** | **2.5/5** — 9-locale table is right, but contradicted by its own "11-locale" blocker; doesn't surface 10-PWA/8-SFCC structure. | **5/5** — 10 PWA / 9 locales / 8 SFCC, `en` default, `en-AU` doc-fix, conflict resolved. Matches ground truth exactly. |
| **E. Handoff clarity** | **4/5** — Strong handoff + ownership + build-checklist tables. | **4/5** — Clear handoff table; lighter on ops build-checklist. |
| **F. Blockers completeness** | **3/5** — Good ops list, but MISSES product-image ownership blocker (asserts it settled) and frames locale blocker wrongly. | **5/5** — Includes product-image contradiction (DC002 empty), SSR/GraphQL/webhook-not-built item, credential hard blocker, all ops items. |
| **G. Briefing quality / house-style** | **3/5** — Comprehensive but no draft banner/prefix/label; Blockers and Open Items duplicate each other. | **4.5/5** — Draft banner + "At a glance" + DoD/Task traceability; still lacks `[DRAFT]` H1 prefix. |
| **H. Factual accuracy & internal consistency** (weighted) | **1.5/5** — Multiple confident false statements + internal contradictions. | **4.5/5** — Verified accurate throughout; only minor *unverifiable* header attributions. |

---

## 2. Factual errors / internal contradictions (ranked)

### Draft ONE
1. **GraphQL asserted as live (false).** "GraphQL for composed pages... **the storefront uses the GraphQL Content API** to fetch only the needed fields" (line 32). No GraphQL exists in the code.
2. **SSR-first asserted as live (false).** "SSR first. Editorial content... **is fetched server-side. The browser hydrates from the SSR payload, no CDA call on first paint**" (line 31), and `useContentful.ts` listed under "Already built" with no qualifier (line 106). The live hook is browser-side REST.
3. **Internal contradiction — locale count.** Main body: "**The Nine Contentful Locales**" presented as resolved (line 161); Blocker #1: "confirm the canonical **11-locale set**... 02-contentful.md says 11" (line 230). Also mislabels the canonical set as 11 (ground truth: 9).
4. **Internal contradiction — CMA token / GH secret.** Bootstrap table: "Generate CI service account CMA token + **store as CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN in GitHub Actions | Complete**" (line 217) vs. "**Add CI service account CMA token as GitHub Actions secret | Incomplete**" (line 224). Ground truth: token generated = complete; adding as GH Actions secret = incomplete.
5. **Three epics treated as stories.** "Returns / Refund Messaging | **SFCC-14**" (line 80), "Z.immerse... | **SFCC-10** | Sprint 5" (line 86), "Mini-cart Shop the Look | **SFCC-11**" (line 87). SFCC-14, -10, -11 are EPICS.
6. **Sprint mis-assignment.** "Checkout Trust Messaging | **SFCC-67**" placed in **Sprint 2** (line 79); its parent epic is Checkout Flow & Delivery = Sprint 4. "Returns / Refund Messaging" also placed in Sprint 2 (returns = Sprint 7).
7. **Unresolved question stated as settled fact.** "Product imagery, SFCC Business Manager static content library" listed flatly under "What is NOT in Contentful" (line 96); product-image ownership is genuinely open (DC002 is empty). Draft ONE flags no blocker for it.
8. **Minor:** "**Six-Tier** Delivery Pipeline" heading over a 7-row table (lines 144-155); "match config/sites.js... **No runtime mapping required**" (line 163) ignores the `SITE_LOCALES`/`contentfulMapping` layer.

### Draft TWO
1. **Unverifiable header attributions.** "**Epic:** SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments" and "**Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang" (line 5) could not be confirmed from ground truth (Owner "Jhoan" is corroborated). Low-impact but asserted with certainty.
2. **Minor unverified cross-refs.** "the '8 storefronts' figure in **SFCC-151**" (line 120) and "Transperfect pipeline (**REG-047**)" (line 148) cite IDs I could not verify (Draft ONE cites HPC-006 for the same Transperfect item; one is likely wrong).
3. **Minor path shorthand** (shared with Draft ONE): cites `config/contentfulMapping.ts`; actual path is `overrides/app/config/contentfulMapping.ts`.

Draft TWO has **no internal contradictions** and **no false code claims**.

---

## 3. Unique strengths (what the other lacks)

**Draft ONE only:**
- Detailed, accurate multi-tier environment/promotion pipeline mapped to real `push:*` scripts, plus the production-alias zero-downtime strategy and `promote:alias` flow.
- Error-handling & monitoring matrix (CDA outage, null fields, HMAC reject, schema drift, migration failure, consent gating).
- Step-by-step developer setup, explicit bootstrap-status table (4 complete / 4 incomplete ops items), and Accenture build checklist.
- Correct concrete detail: SDK v11, CSP allowances, connection-pool decision.

**Draft TWO only:**
- Verified "current vs target" reality (browser-side REST; SSR/GraphQL/webhook not built) — the single most important fact for the incoming squad.
- Exact current code inventory: 3 named Studio Experiences + 1 CDA type + verified `shoppableImage` field shape + the SCAPI product-resolution pattern.
- Correct locale resolution (10 PWA/9 locales/8 SFCC, `en-AU` doc-fix) and the product-image ownership blocker (DC002 empty).
- DoD/Task traceability tags, "At a glance" summary, draft banner, and a "doc fix to feed back" for `02-contentful.md §7`.

---

## 4. Verdict

**Draft TWO is the better SFCC-123 solution. Confidence: high.** For a briefing artefact a downstream squad will act on, the decisive axis is factual accuracy and current-vs-target honesty, and Draft TWO is accurate to the line where Draft ONE repeatedly presents the *target* architecture (SSR-first, GraphQL, publish-webhook) and *unresolved* questions (locale count, product-image ownership) as settled current fact, while also contradicting itself internally. Draft ONE is the more operationally detailed document, but that polish sits on an inaccurate foundation, which is exactly the failure mode the DoD's "ready to brief the incoming squad" bar cannot tolerate.

---

## 5. Merge recommendation

**Base = Draft TWO.** Port the following *from Draft ONE into Draft TWO*, correcting them on the way in:
1. The multi-tier environment/promotion table and production-alias strategy (accurate; missing from TWO) — reconcile the "Six-Tier" label to the 7 rows.
2. The error-handling & monitoring matrix.
3. The developer setup steps + the bootstrap-status table + Accenture build checklist — **but fix** the CMA-token/GH-secret status (generated = complete; add-as-GH-secret = incomplete) and drop the "11-locale" framing (canonical = 9).

**Do NOT port from Draft ONE:** its content-model sprint assignments (epics-as-stories SFCC-14/-10/-11; checkout/returns mislabeled Sprint 2), and any framing that presents SSR/GraphQL/webhook as currently implemented. Add `[DRAFT]` to Draft TWO's H1 to complete house-style compliance (banner and dash rules already pass).

- `scripts/contentful/content-types/` — **exactly 1 CDA content type**: `shoppableImage.js`.
- `config/sites.overlay.js` — **10 PWA sites, 9 distinct Contentful locales** (`en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`, `fr`, `it`, `es`, `en-CH`, `en-HK`, `en-AE`). `contentfulMapping.generated.ts` `SUPPORTED_LOCALES` matches those 9 exactly; `DEFAULT_LOCALE = 'en'`; `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD = 'productId'`; `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENTS` exists. `sites.generated.js` lists `en-AU` as AU's BM defaultLocale (overlay narrows to `en`).
- `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves product images from **SFCC via `useProduct` (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) + `disBaseLink`** — corroborating that product imagery leans SFCC, not Contentful.
- npm scripts referenced by BOTH drafts exist (`push:dev…push:prod`, `sync:contentful`, `setup:contentful`, `migrate:contentful`, `promote:alias`, `detect:drift`, `generate:contentful`, `sync:regional-config`). `contentful` dep is `^11.12.4` (Draft ONE's "SDK v11" is accurate).

> "a TSD addresses one problem/solution, not 'all the other stuff'... Keep every section lean and **LINK the sources... do not reproduce them**."

and the template's source list is headed **"PRIMARY SOURCES to pull from (link, don't re-type)."** Draft (a) was built from this template; draft (b) was not. Re-scored against this standard (plus the code/Confluence/Jira facts already verified), the verdict gets stronger and one of my earlier points reverses.

## Updated verdict

**(a) [351207428] is the sanctioned solution, now on two independent grounds: factual accuracy *and* conformance to the approved template / Tim's scope rule. Confidence: high.**

What changed from my first pass: I had credited (b)'s operational depth (env topology, alias workflow, dev-setup steps, bootstrap status, build checklist, error matrix, ownership/billing tables) as a *strength*. **Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

## 3. SFCC-side consumption & build scope [DoD-4 · Task-3]

- **Data hooks:** `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`; REST CDA/CPA with linked-asset resolution).
- **Editorial components:** `components/contentful/{heroBanner, duplexSection, videoEmbed, productHero}.tsx`.

- **Locale source of truth:** `config/sites.overlay.js` + `config/sites.generated.js` + `contentfulMapping.generated.ts`, regenerated in one pass via `npm run sync:regional-config` (see §4).

content.content:
1	> **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.
2	
3	# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)
4	
5	> **Status:** In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
6	> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
7	> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## At a glance
12	
13	- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
14	- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
15	- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
16	- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
17	- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
18	- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.
19	
20	---
21	
22	## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]
23	
24	**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.
25	
26	- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
27	- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.
28	
29	Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).
30	
31	## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]
32	
33	**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.
34	
35	```
36	PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
37	   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
38	   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
39	   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
40	   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
41	   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
42	```
43	
44	| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
45	|---|---|---|---|
46	| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
47	| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
48	| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
49	| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |
50	
51	CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).
52	
53	> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.
54	
55	## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]
56	
57	**What exists in code today (verified):**
58	
59	- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in `experiences/definitions.ts`, autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
60	- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
61	- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).
62	
63	Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).
64	
65	**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the navigation / mega menu, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert), the PDP size-guide fallback, and the PDP product-information accordion; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.

78	| PDP size-guide fallback | Per-product-type size guide slide-out (non-Measmerize) | 2 | No | [SFCC-102](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-102) (In Refinement) | to build (SFCC-owned overlay) |
79	| PDP product information accordion | Shipping & Returns / Assistance tabs, rich text, per storefront | 2 | No | [SFCC-195](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-195) (In Refinement) | to build |
80	| SEO FAQ / Article schema | JSON-LD structured data authored in Contentful | Backlog (Enhancements) | No | [SFCC-173](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-173) (To Do) | to build |
81	| (existing, unmapped) | `productHero`, `videoEmbed` components exist without a confirmed content type | - | Yes (component only) | - | `components/contentful/{productHero,videoEmbed}.tsx` |
82	
83	**Field reference (verified):**
84	
85	- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
86	- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
87	- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
88	- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.
89	
90	For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

> **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.

# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

**What exists in code today (verified):**

- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in `experiences/definitions.ts`, autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).

Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).

**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the navigation / mega menu, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert), the PDP size-guide fallback, and the PDP product-information accordion; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.

| PDP product information accordion | Shipping & Returns / Assistance tabs, rich text, per storefront | 2 | No | [SFCC-195](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-195) (In Refinement) | to build |
| SEO FAQ / Article schema | JSON-LD structured data authored in Contentful | Backlog (Enhancements) | No | [SFCC-173](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-173) (To Do) | to build |
| (existing, unmapped) | `productHero`, `videoEmbed` components exist without a confirmed content type | - | Yes (component only) | - | `components/contentful/{productHero,videoEmbed}.tsx` |

**Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

## 4. Locale configuration [DoD-3 · Task-4]

**Resolved.** The earlier "locale count" conflict was a category error, not a data conflict:

- **8 SFCC sites / storefront catalogues** (Business Manager view): AU, UK, US, USIntl, EU, EUIntl, HK, ME. > **DRAFT: Spike SFCC-123.** Working briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and Jira as of 22 Jul 2026. Not yet ratified by the squad; open items and the handoff boundary are not final.

# TSD: Contentful Integration, SFCC-Side Design & Content Model (SFCC-123)

> **Status:** In progress · **Owner:** Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz · **Reporter:** Jasmijn Tsang · **Epic:** [SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-1) · **Updated:** 2026-07-22
> **Audience:** the incoming Contentful squad (briefing artefact) plus Squad A engineers building the SFCC-side connection.
> **Provenance:** seeded from the SFCC-123 template and fact-checked against the codebase, Confluence, and the linked Jira stories on 2026-07-22. Items still unconfirmed are called out as open, never asserted as fact.

---

## At a glance

- **What this is:** the SFCC-side briefing for the incoming Contentful squad, covering integration architecture, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and build scope. It is the work tracked as Open Item #3 on the Product TSD.
- **State of play:** the integration is substantially scaffolded (config, data hooks, Studio Experiences, schema-as-code tooling, CSP, CI drift checks), but the SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, the publish-webhook receiver, and most editorial content types are still to build.
- **Content model today:** one CDA content type (`shoppableImage`) plus three Studio Experiences (`collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`). Everything else in §2 is to build.
- **Locale:** 8 SFCC sites, 10 PWA sites, 9 Contentful locales (`en` default). The earlier count conflict is resolved (§4).
- **Hard blocker:** Contentful must provide per-environment credentials before the storefront can connect (§6 item 8).
- **Read next:** §2 for content types by sprint, §3 for what SFCC consumes, §6 for what must be unblocked before onboarding.

---

## 0. Purpose & scope [Task-5 framing]

**Problem this TSD solves:** give the incoming Contentful squad, and Squad A, a single briefing that pins down the Contentful-to-SFCC integration pattern, the content model SFCC must consume, locale setup, and the SFCC-side build scope, so the two teams share one boundary before the dedicated Contentful squad onboards.

- **In scope:** SFCC/MRT-side integration design, content-model requirements SFCC must consume, locale configuration, and the Accenture-vs-Contentful-squad handoff boundary.
- **Out of scope:** the full Contentful setup owned by the incoming squad (content authoring, Studio operations, the separate Contentful SOW). Linked, not specified here.

Contentful is the sole CMS across all Zimmermann storefronts (HPC-001): editorial modules, banners, size-guide fallback content, promotional content, and global assets. SFCC owns all commerce data; Contentful owns editorial. This spike is the same work item tracked as Open Item #3 ("Define Contentful content model and connector customisation scope") on [TSD: Product, SFCC Catalogue & Data Integration](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/292061208). Ticket: [SFCC-123](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-123).

## 1. Integration architecture & data flow [DoD-1 · Task-1]

**Target pattern** (per `.docs/integration/02-contentful.md` §3-§5 and [Technical Solution Design, PWA](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SFCC/pages/256835585) §7): Contentful to MRT (Node/SSR) to browser, SSR-first for SEO and LCP.

```
PWA (SSR, then CSR hydration)
   ├──► Contentful Delivery API (CDA)      published content, SSR + browser; public token, safe in bundle
   ├──► Contentful Preview API (CPA)        drafts, MRT proxy only; token server-side, never in browser
   ├──► Contentful Images API               images.ctfassets.net, srcset/sizes, AVIF then WebP fallback
   ├──► GraphQL Content API                 composed pages, one request, field-projected
   └──◄  Publish webhook → MRT /webhooks/contentful   HMAC-verified; clears SSR cache keys
```

| Surface | Origin / boundary | Token | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CDA (published) | Browser + SSR | `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` (public, read-only) | SSR-first target; held as an MRT env var so rotation is centralised |
| CPA (drafts) | MRT proxy only | `CONTENTFUL_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (server-side) | Studio live preview via iframe `postMessage` |
| CMA (schema sync) | CI / local only | `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` | Never in MRT or the bundle; build-time only |
| Publish webhook | Contentful to MRT | `CMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC) | Cache purge; 60s SWR TTL fallback |

CDN limit: 55 uncached requests per second per CDA token, absorbed by the SSR cache. Single Contentful Space, one environment per delivery tier (see §4).

> **Current implementation vs target (verified in code).** The live data layer is `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts`: two hooks (`useContentfulEntry`, `useContentfulEntries`) that fetch **browser-side over REST** from `cdn.contentful.com` (CDA) or `preview.contentful.com` (CPA) with `include=2` to resolve linked assets. Config comes from `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` via `getContentfulConfig()` (which wraps the PWA Kit `ssr-config` `getConfig()`). The **SSR-first fetch, the GraphQL Content API, and the publish-webhook receiver are documented as the target but are not yet in the code** (see §3 and §6, items 3 and 10). This is deliberate build scope, not a defect, but the briefing should not imply SSR editorial is live today.

## 2. Content model requirements [DoD-2 · Task-2]

**What exists in code today (verified):**

- **Studio Experiences** (drag-and-drop, registered via `@contentful/experiences-sdk-react` in `experiences/definitions.ts`, autogenerated from the `.tsx` sources): `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`.
- **CDA content type as schema-as-code** (`scripts/contentful/content-types/`): only `shoppableImage`. Registered in `CONTENT_TYPE_IDS` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- **Editorial React components without a confirmed content type**: `heroBanner`, `duplexSection`, `videoEmbed`, `productHero` (`components/contentful/index.ts`).

Contentful integration is not a separate sprint: per `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md`, "Contentful works/integration will be done as part of each corresponding functional story." Sprint columns below follow the functional-area schedule (today is Sprint 2, 13-24 Jul).

**Required by sprint (Task-2):** Sprint 1 (Homepage & Navigation, Part 1) needs the homepage/navigation editorial types: `collection-hero`, `image-text`, `shoppable-image`, the homepage modules, the navigation / mega menu, the promotional announcement banner, and the global footer. Sprint 2 adds the PLP editorial types (bottom-zone slots and inline grid insert), the PDP size-guide fallback, and the PDP product-information accordion; the SEO FAQ/Article schema sits in the Enhancements backlog. Per each UI story, component shells can be built with mock content ahead of the content model, which is what the "Exists in code?" column reflects. The `Sprint` value in the table is the sprint by which each type is first required.

**Field reference (verified):**

- `shoppableImage` CDA type: `title` (Symbol, required), `image` (Asset link, required), `imageAlt` (Symbol), `hotspots` (Object; shape `[{ x: 0-100, y: 0-100, productId: "<SFCC master product ID>" }]`). The `productId` key is fixed by `SFCC_PRODUCT_ID_FIELD` in `contentfulMapping.ts`.
- Studio Experience `shoppable-image` stores `hotspots` as a JSON **Text** variable (versus the CDA type's `Object`); worth reconciling to one representation when the model is formalised.
- Studio Experience variables: `collection-hero` (headline, subheadline, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, backgroundImage/Media); `image-text` (image/Media, imageAlt, headline, body, imagePosition default `left`).
- Shoppable-image runtime (verified): `experiences/shoppableImage.tsx` parses the `hotspots` JSON into `{x, y, productId}` markers; `hotspotPopup.tsx` resolves each `productId` through the `useProduct` SCAPI hook (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`) and renders the SFCC product image (SFCC DIS via `disBaseLink`), name, price, and a PDP link. This is the concrete pattern for Contentful entries that reference SFCC products.

For each **required** type still to build, the incoming squad and Squad A must agree the field set and which fields are localised (`localized: true`) versus structural (`localized: false`, e.g. asset links and product IDs). Schema-as-code lives at `scripts/contentful/content-types/*.js`; Studio Experience definitions are generated from `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/*.tsx` via `npm run generate:contentful`.

Objective: document the Contentful→MRT→SFCC integration + data flow, define Sprint 1/2 content types, define what SFCC consumes (APIs, fields, rendering), locale config across the storefronts, and the Accenture-vs-incoming-Contentful-squad handoff boundary. Comparative analysis verdict (2026-07-22, high confidence, cross-checked by a blind reviewer): **(a) is the better solution** on two grounds — factual accuracy (b asserts SSR/GraphQL/webhook as built when code is browser-side REST; contradicts itself on locale 9-vs-11 and CMA-token status; cites epics SFCC-14/11/10 as stories; mis-scopes checkout/returns into Sprint 2) AND conformance to the approved template + Tim's TSD focus rule (see [[tsd-scope-principle]]) — (b) reproduces env topology/dev-setup/bootstrap/ownership "other stuff" the template says to LINK not reproduce.
